candidate.user_input: When using the Navan Travel virtual card to pay for hotel stays, under what conditions must I still submit an expense report?
candidate.reference: You do not need to submit an expense report if you only incur the hotel room charges and applicable taxes paid by the Navan Travel virtual card. However, you must submit an expense reports for any business-related incidental expenses, such as room service, parking, minibar, or other extras.
reference_contexts:
### Hotels

- When you book Hotels through Navan Travel, hotel room charges and the applicable taxes will be paid directly by GitLab through a central virtual card - the same way the company handles flights and train travel. The virtual card details will appear in Navan, our travel and expense platform, 24 hours before check-in and the hotel will automatically charge your room and taxes to this card.
- If you do not incur any additional hotel charges, there will be no need to submit an expense report for your stay.
- You will still be required to provide a personal credit card at check-in for any potential charges, such as room service, parking, minibar, or other extras.
- Incidental expenses that are business-related and within policy still are required to be submitted through an expense report.
- Further information can be found on [Navan Help Centre](https://app.navan.com/app/helpcenter/articles/travel/myself/booking-hotels/virtual-cards-for-pay-at-hotel-bookings)
- When hotel rooms are booked outside Navan - approval required by Manager and AP Admin.
- Hotel stays are reimbursable up to $300 USD (or equivalent local currency) inclusive of tax per night for standard rooms, with a 7 day booking lead time.
- However, the lodging policy in Navan is set up as a “Dynamic Policy” which calculates a fair market price for every search based on travel dates and destinations. This allows for some room in price in case the $300 USD limit is really not applicable to that area. And similar to airfare, any purchases that are over 20% of the Dynamic Policy will be flagged for further review by your manager.
- Always choose the refundable room booking unless the only available option is a non refundable room.
- The exception is the Corporate Events hotel room blocks organized by the internal team or if the conference hotel room block has better pricing than Navan.
- The hotel room block's pricing is generally within the bounds of the $300USD/night and in the event it is over that amount, please contact the AP team for an exception to be granted.
- Conference hotel room blocks or Corporate Events organized blocks will still need to be charged to a personal credit card and then submitted for reimbursement via Navan Expense.
- Always bring a credit card with you when traveling for company business if you have one. Hotels will generally expect you to have a physical credit card to present upon check-in. This credit card will be kept on file for the duration of your stay. Even if your lodging was pre-paid by the company or by using a company credit card, the Hotel may still require a card to be on file for "incidentals".

source_conditions: Hotel room charges and applicable taxes paid by GitLab via Navan Travel virtual card do not require an expense report if no additional charges are incurred.
A personal credit card must be provided at check-in for potential charges such as room service, parking, minibar, or other extras.
Business-related incidental expenses within policy must be submitted through an expense report.
